title: The Next Web's 'More Than 70 UK Lawmakers Ask Burnham to Back a Superintelligence Ban' Buries the Admission That Makes the Ban Pointless
short_version: The AISI head told MPs in October he has no power to stop a dangerous model from shipping. The superintelligence ban bill proposes to ban something that nobody currently has the power to hold. Seventy MPs, one missing lever.
